app.name: CrossBorder Assist
app.description: Know what documents and official fees apply to your goods before you reach the border.

landing.title: Know what you need before you reach the border.
landing.body: Tell us your route, your goods and their value. You get a checklist of documents and official fees, with the source for each one.
landing.noAccount: No account needed to see your checklist.

route.title: Your route
route.body: Where you start, where you are going and which crossing you use.

goods.title: Your goods
goods.body: Search by the name you use at the market.

value.title: Their value
value.body: In shillings. We convert it for the rules that use dollars.

landing.trustTitle: Every item shows where it comes from
landing.trustNote: When we are not sure, we say so and tell you who to ask.

route.title: Where are you taking your goods?
route.otherBody: Not covered yet. Ask the Trade Information Desk at your crossing.

product.title: What are you taking?
product.searchLabel: Search by any name you use
product.searchHint: Press Search on your keyboard to see matches.
product.noMatches: No goods match “{query}”. Try another name.
product.skip: Can't find it? <link>Continue without a match</link> and we will tell you who to ask.

value.title: How much are you taking, and what is it worth?
value.usdEmpty: Enter a value to see it in dollars.
value.usdRate: At {rate} {currency} per dollar, the rate our team set on {date}. Customs may use a different rate.
value.usdRateIllustrative: This rate is an example for the prototype.
value.usdNoRate: We do not have a current rate for {currency}. We cannot convert your value, so we will tell you who to ask.
value.threshold: Consignments worth up to USD {amount} per crossing may use the Simplified Trade Regime, if the goods are on the Common List.
value.errorQuantity: Enter how many you are taking.
value.errorValue: Enter what your goods are worth.

result.summaryNoProduct: Goods not matched. {quantity} {unit} worth {currency} {value}, {from} to {to} through {border}.
result.caveat: This is guidance, not clearance. Border officials make the final decision.
result.noChecklist: We do not have a verified checklist for this case. Use the contacts below.
result.signInNote: You will be asked to sign in when you save.
result.helpBody: Ask the Trade Information Desk at {border}. {contact}
result.helpNoContact: Ask the Trade Information Desk at {border}.

verdict.likely_str_eligible: Likely eligible for the Simplified Trade Regime
verdict.above_threshold: Above USD {threshold}: the standard customs procedure applies
verdict.above_threshold_generic: Above the Simplified Trade Regime limit: the standard customs procedure applies
verdict.not_on_common_list: This product is not on the Common List
verdict.cannot_confirm: We can't confirm the rules for this trade

trust.unknownBody: We have no source for this item. Ask the Trade Information Desk before you travel.

disclaimer: This platform provides informational decision support based on referenced sources. It is not a customs authority, legal adviser, tax authority or government service. Verify current requirements with the relevant official authority before you trade.

share.title: My trade plan
share.footer: Built with CrossBorder Assist. This is guidance, not clearance.

plans.title: Saved plans
plans.ruleChanged: A rule in this plan changed since you saved it. Open to see what is new.
